source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 from the quadratic character of GF(337). The base array has entry 1 at row x and column y when x + y is a nonzero square modulo 337 and 0 when it is a non-square; the 337 cells with x + y = 0 are left free. 192 of the 337 columns were chosen by simulated annealing to minimise the patterns on sets of five columns that the base rows leave uncovered (programs/subsel.c, seed 1, 1,500,000 moves, temperature 1.0; the chosen columns are programs/sub_T1.0.txt). A simulated annealing search over the free diagonal cells and 9 added rows (programs/ls2m.c, seed 1, 35,363,840 moves, temperature 0.35) left 113 patterns uncovered, and an exact repair that flips single cells anywhere in the array and keeps exact lists of uncovered and uniquely covered patterns (programs/repcm.c, seed 1 for 99 iterations, then seed 2) reached 0. programs/run_recipe.sh runs every step and checks the sha256 of each file; a second run from scratch gave the same array (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Cyclotomic (quadratic character) array for q = 337 restricted to 192 columns chosen by simulated annealing, with its diagonal cells and 9 added rows chosen by simulated annealing and exact single-cell repair
notes: answers the cited size 346 at k = 192 (tie); no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
